notes: Cursor is keyset over (recorded_at, rowid), never engine seq: seq is one global counter shared by threads, so a hole in it is interleaving, not loss. event_gaps remains the only loss record.
Schema v10 is additive and nullable; pre-v10 rows keep item_id NULL and are reported as unknown identity rather than inferred from payload or kind.
Legacy completions bind to an unidentified stream only when exactly one stream of that kind in that turn can be its source; otherwise the completion stands alone.
Partial cards reload one item (bounded at 4,000 frames) or state that the beginning cannot be reconstructed. No whole-transcript backfill and no invented text.
Scroll anchoring keys on olderLoads (a completed page read), so live appends never move a reader. scroll-behavior:smooth was removed because it made follow-scroll look like leaving the live edge.
currentThreadId prefers the deterministic local thread id over most-recently-updated, so an archived thread cannot be labelled current.
One earlier shell-smoke run reported terminal_output:false; the terminal path is untouched and the immediate rerun was 127/127. Recorded in the R02 evidence instead of hidden.

The 24 shell captures regenerated by the shell smoke were re-recorded through monabuild evidence with a note that the previous hash described the pre-R02 bytes; R00/R01 source hashes for files R02 changed are marked historical, not refreshed.
